glosses: nie należący do żadnego ze stronnictw albo partii politycznych

examples.text: This means Gore will have to stop dancing away from the question as if the pardon decision were somehow shared with the pardonee. glosses: One who is not a partisan.
A person who has not selected or declared a side or party.

examples.text: “The first thing is that nonpartisans as a group are occasional voters,” Mr. DiCamillo said. “They are not as engaged in politics. They view the parties as being too partisan and migrated to nonpartisan.”

glosses: Que procede o juzga sin tomar partido, permaneciendo neutral, con objetividad.
